fields.title: A contents entry that points inside a chapter lands on its own word
fields.description: A contents entry whose link points into the middle of a section (an href with a fragment) lands on its section's first word, because `resolveTocWordIndex` maps by section only. Five of the 23 entries in Meditations do this. Map the fragment to its own word.
